sentences.en: This is a great time-saving gadget for the housewife.
sentences.zh: 这是一款非常实用的省时小玩意，特别适合家庭主妇使用。

sentences.en: There were kitchen gadgets including toasters, kettles and percolators.
sentences.zh: 厨房里有许多精巧的小玩意，比如烤面包机、水壶和咖啡机。

sentences.en: This gadget is light years ahead of any other.
sentences.zh: 这款小玩意比其他任何东西都先进得多。

senses.zh: 小器具；小装置；精巧的小玩意儿 形容词: gadgety
